text:
alex_sales: Heads-up — AcmeHealth POC ready for final contract. They sent a PO and want MSA/DPA tweaks + explicit SLA credit table. PO attached. Need legal + procurement to advise on signer order and whether we can split PO across their US and EU entities. PO: PO# AH-20260321-77, Net30 by default.

maria_legal: Can you confirm which MSA version they received? We have v3.2 (AMENDMENT 2025) live. If they redlined changes, need to see diffs. Also they removed the standard liability cap — that's a blocker.

alex_sales: They uploaded an annotated MSA (pdf) — main asks: (1) increase liability cap from 1M to 5M, (2) DPA addendum: add data residency clause EU only, (3) SLA: 99.9% w/ service credits spelled out. Attached PO references Net45. They prefer exec signature on orderform not MSA.

maria_legal: Liability cap increase is non-starter without commercial signoff. Can procurement confirm revenue band? If they want exec sig on orderform, legal needs to lock down indemnities and IP carveouts. Also request redline of the DPA rather than comments.

jordan_procure: From buying team: they are splitting invoicing: 70% to AcmeHealth US (billing), 30% to AcmeHealth EU (data residency). PO can be split lines. We need to map signers: US CFO and EU Head of Procurement. Can finance accept multi-invoice split?

nina_finance: Multi-invoice split is fine; need billing contacts + VAT details. Net45 vs Net30: we can accept Net45 for this enterprise POC but need SOW or orderform to reference payment terms explicitly. Send billing instructions.

sam_se: Technical note — for EU-only data workloads we must run private deployment (VPC in eu-central). Acme asked for KMS/HSM proof and SOC2 report. I've attached the infra checklist and a snippet of our KMS page.

liam_infra: Pinged infra for a brief addendum: "We will provision eu-central private deployment and KMS integration; audit logs exported to their SIEM via SFTP" — need to confirm SLA impact (slightly longer provisioning time).

acme_pm: FYI — we're ready to sign, but legal asked for the liability cap. Customer prefers to keep execes off the MSA and sign the orderform only. They can route CFO first then vendor exec.

docusign_bot: docusign: envelope created by alex_sales for OrderForm #AH-20260321-77. status: waiting for signer mapping.

maria_legal: Proposal: we accept orderform-only exec sign if (a) MSA reference is explicit (MSA v3.2 incorporated by reference), (b) liability cap remains at 1M but add limited carveouts for security incidents up to 5M for regulated workloads, (c) DPA addendum limited to EU residency for subset of tokens. Legal to produce redline by EOD.

jordan_procure: Confirming split PO lines and signer list. Jordan to draft purchase order routing instruction. Do we need PO numbers for both entities? Also need to know if payment via ACH or Wire.

alex_sales: @nina_finance — can we accept wire for EU split? Also @maria_legal please attach the redline here when ready. I'll update customer routing so CFO signs orderform first then our CRO.

nina_finance: Wire is fine. Send invoicing email to billing@acmehealth-us.com and billing-eu@acmehealth-eu.com. Include VAT ID for EU.

maria_legal: Uploaded redline: "MSA_v3.2_redline_AcmeHealth_3141592653.pdf". Main change: carveout for regulatory fines removed; liability cap preserved but security carveout conditional on validated SOC2 + KMS attestation. Requesting quick review from sales and infra.

liam_infra: Reviewed redline. KMS attestation planned — we can provide key rotation policy and HSM cert. Provisioning timeline: 5-7 business days post-signature.

sam_se: Suggest adding a single clause in orderform: "Services covered under EU Data Residency are subject to private deployment attachment and provisioning timelines" — keeps execs happy.

alex_sales: Next steps: (1) Jordan to produce split PO with two invoice lines and CFO/EU signer names (2) Maria will finalize redline if procurement accepts split billing flow (3) Nina to confirm invoice banking details and payment terms (4) I'll route DocuSign envelope waiting on signer mapping. Aiming for signatures by Friday.

acme_pm: I'll circulate signer names today. Thanks all.

maria_legal: I'll iterate redline to be final and drop into this thread once done. If procurement confirms routing we can approve orderform-only exec signature with our standard incorporation-by-reference clause.

alex_sales: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — flag if blockers. I'll follow up with docu sign mapping in ~30m.
